trap-superlative.evidence: Block-final: 'Without the formal-groups integration theorem, the p-adic lifting mechanism would remain a conjecture. The results of Fresse convert it into a PROVEN categorical lift.' Chased per the 'superlative is a defect detector' rule and the support is not there. grep -i fresse over folio/schema/references.ts returns nothing, and neither skew-poisson-integration.ts nor skew-poisson-integration-proof.ts declares a cites field - so the theorem that converts a conjecture into a proven lift has no bibliography entry anywhere in the corpus. The proof block itself is seven lines that attribute all three items to 'the Main Theorem of Fresse' and reference an item (3) the proposition does not have. Per AGENTS.md sec 'Axiomatization is NOT a Proof', an uncitable attribution does not make a lift proven.
